metadata.scenario: A patient wants to book a follow-up appointment after their recent surgery to ensure proper recovery. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson. Nice to meet you, Patricia! How can we help you today? I'm calling because my mother needs post-surgery care after her upcoming hip replacement. I see. That's very important. When is her surgery scheduled? It's scheduled for next Thursday, so we’d need care starting the following week. Great! We can definitely help with that. Would you like to schedule a follow-up appointment for after her surgery? Yes, I’d like to get that arranged. What services do you offer for post-surgery care? We provide specialized Post-Surgery Recovery Care, which includes monitoring, assistance with daily activities, and mobility support. That sounds perfect. How long do those sessions typically last? They typically last between 1 to 3 hours, and the pricing ranges from $85 to $110 per visit. Okay. I think we’d need someone for about two hours each day initially. That sounds reasonable. What days are you looking at for the care? We’d like someone for Monday through Friday after her surgery. Got it. Would you prefer morning or afternoon sessions? Mornings would be best, around 9 AM if possible. Let me check our availability for that time slot. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I see we have availability for 9 AM Monday through Friday, starting the following week. Would you like me to book that? Yes, please go ahead and book it. Perfect! I’ll set up Post-Surgery Recovery Care for your mother from 9 AM to 11 AM. Thank you! Is there anything else I need to do? Just a few details to confirm for the care plan. Can I have your mother's name and any specific needs she may have? Her name is Helen Wilson, and she may need assistance with mobility and pain management. Thank you, Patricia. I will note that in her care plan. Appreciate it! Is there anything else I should know about the costs? Just that we can assist with insurance authorization if needed. Would you like me to provide that information? Yes, that would be helpful! I’ll arrange for our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, to reach out to you about insurance options. Sounds good. Thank you for all your help, Margaret! You’re welcome, Patricia! We’re looking forward to helping your mother. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
